fields.name: event
fields.description: The action. An unknown value does nothing and gets the success reply.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The action is done. Also: `leave` or `kick` when you are not in a party, `kick` of a name that is not in your party, and an unknown `event`.

fields.name: response
fields.description: Always `"data"`.

fields.name: place
fields.description: The request.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `true`.

responses.name: Already in party
responses.when: `invite` or `request`: the target is in your party. `accept` or `raccept`: you and the other character are in the same party. Nothing changes.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: place
fields.description: The request.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `true`.

failures.intro: Only the checks of the action in `event` run. A full party has `limits.party_max` (10) members, or `limits.party` (9) members that are not merchants (`party_length`, node/server.js:1185).

rows.when: No character.

list.when: Invites a character to your party. The server does not check that you are the leader.

fields.name: id
fields.coerce: none: `data.id || data.name`, used as a key of `name_to_id`
fields.description: The target. The server uses it first, then `name`.

fields.name: name
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `name_to_id`
fields.description: The target, when `id` is absent. Give `id` or `name`.

rows.when: You are in a party, and it is full.
The target is not online on this server, or it is you.
The target is in your party. Nothing changes.

also.when: Success. The invite stays open until the target accepts it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: You: the name to send back in `accept`.

list.when: Asks to join the party of a character.

fields.name: id
fields.coerce: none: `data.id || data.name`, used as a key of `name_to_id`
fields.description: The target. The server uses it first, then `name`.

fields.name: name
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `name_to_id`
fields.description: The target, when `id` is absent. Give `id` or `name`.

rows.when: The target is not online on this server, or it is you.
The target is in your party. Nothing changes.

also.when: Success. The request stays open until the target accepts it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: You: the name to send back in `raccept`.

list.when: Accepts an invite. You join the party of the inviter. The server removes you from your old party first.

fields.name: name
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `name_to_id`
fields.description: The character that invited you (the `name` of the `invite` event).

rows.when: The character in `name` is not online.
The inviter is in a party, and it is full.
The inviter did not invite you, or you used the invite already.
You and the inviter are in the same party. Nothing changes.
The inviter had no party, and the server made one. Then the inviter went offline during the sends of the server. You left your old party already.

also.name: Left old party
also.when: You were in another party, and the server removes you from it first.
also.summary: `{}`: not in a party now. A `game_log` with phrase `server.game_log.left_your_current_party` follows.

also.name: Member left
also.to: the members of your old party
also.when: You were in another party. Each member also gets `player`.
also.summary: A `LocalizedText` with phrase `server.party.left`, plus `leave: 1`, `list` and `party`. When fewer than 2 members stay, the party ends: `list` is `false` and `party` is `{}`.

also.name: Joined
also.when: Success. Every member of the party gets it, you too. The phrase is `server.party.joined_with_invite` when the inviter is not the leader.

fields.name: list
fields.description: The members in order. The first is the leader.

fields.name: party
fields.description: Member name to `{skin, level, type, x, y, in, map, share, pdps, l, xp, luck, gold, rip?, cx?}` (`party_to_client`, node/server.js:1138-1213).

also.when: To the inviter if the server made a new party. Then to you on success.
also.summary: The state with the new `party` value.

order: if you were in another party: `party_update` + `player` to its members, then `party_update` `{}` and `game_log` to you
if the inviter had no party: `player` to the inviter

list.when: Accepts a request to join. The requester joins your party. The server removes the requester from its old party first.

fields.name: name
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `name_to_id`
fields.description: The character that asked to join (the `name` of the `request` event).

rows.when: The character in `name` is not online.
You are in a party, and it is full.
The character did not ask to join you, or you accepted the request already.
You and the requester are in the same party. Nothing changes.
The requester left its old party, and then went offline during the sends of the server.

also.name: Requester left old party
also.when: The requester was in another party, and the server removes it from it first.
also.summary: `{}`: not in a party now. A `game_log` with phrase `server.game_log.left_the_party` follows.

also.name: Member left
also.to: the members of the old party of the requester
also.when: The requester was in another party. Each member also gets `player`.
also.summary: A `LocalizedText` with phrase `server.party.left`, plus `leave: 1`, `list` and `party`. When fewer than 2 members stay, the party ends: `list` is `false` and `party` is `{}`.

also.name: Joined
also.when: Success. Every member of the party gets it, the requester too.

fields.name: list
fields.description: The members in order. The first is the leader.

fields.name: party
fields.description: Member name to `{skin, level, type, x, y, in, map, share, pdps, l, xp, luck, gold, rip?, cx?}` (`party_to_client`, node/server.js:1138-1213).

also.when: To you if the server made a new party. Then to the requester on success.
also.summary: The state with the new `party` value.

order: if the requester was in another party: `party_update` + `player` to its members, then `party_update` `{}` and `game_log` to the requester
if you had no party: `player` to you

list.when: Leaves your party. The server ignores `name`. A party of 2 ends when one member leaves.

also.name: Member left
also.when: You were in a party. Each member also gets `player`.
also.summary: A `LocalizedText` with phrase `server.party.left`, plus `leave: 1`, `list` and `party`. When fewer than 2 members stay, the party ends: `list` is `false` and `party` is `{}`.

also.name: Left
also.when: Always, also when you are not in a party.
also.summary: `{}`: not in a party now. In a party, a `game_log` with phrase `server.game_log.left_the_party` follows.
The state with the new `party` value.

list.when: Removes a member from your party. You can remove only the members after you in `list`, and yourself. The leader is first, so the leader can remove every member.

fields.name: name
fields.coerce: none: compared with the names in the party (`in_arr`)
fields.description: The member to remove.

rows.when: You are not in a party. Nothing changes.
`name` is not in your party. Nothing changes.

replies.note: your party now; `party` trimmed to one member

rows.when: The member is before you in the list of the party (`list`).
The member is not online. It has no `name` field.

also.name: Member left
also.summary: A `LocalizedText` with phrase `server.party.left`, plus `leave: 1`, `list` and `party`. When fewer than 2 members stay, the party ends: `list` is `false` and `party` is `{}`.

also.name: Kicked
also.when: Success, if the party still exists (it ends when 1 member stays).

also.name: Removed
also.summary: `{}`: not in a party now. A `game_log` with phrase `server.game_log.you_ve_been_removed_from_the_party` follows.
The state with the new `party` value.
